mission.title: spiffe: Support for sidecar-less service meshes
mission.description: Support for sidecar-less service meshes. Requested by 9+ users.

steps.title: Check current spiffe deployment
steps.description:
Verify your spiffe version and configuration:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n spiffe -l app.kubernetes.io/name=spiffe
helm list -n spiffe 2>/dev/null || echo "Not installed via Helm"
```
This feature requires a working spiffe installation.

steps.title: Review spiffe configuration
steps.description:
Inspect the relevant spiffe configuration:
```bash
kubectl get all -n spiffe -l app.kubernetes.io/name=spiffe
kubectl get configmap -n spiffe -l app.kubernetes.io/part-of=spiffe
```
The Workload API the way it is designed (and also implemented today) does not support service mesh deployments with node-level proxies such as Istio Ambient Mesh.

steps.title: Apply the fix for Support for sidecar-less service meshes

The channel authentication happens before the HTTP2 Settings Frame. Calling an RPC would require HTTP2 to be established though and thus it's a kind of a chicken & egg problem.

steps.title: Verify the feature works
steps.description:
Test that the new capability is working as expected:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n spiffe -l app.kubernetes.io/name=spiffe
kubectl get events -n spiffe --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' | tail -10
```
Confirm the feature described in "Support for sidecar-less service meshes" is functioning correctly.
